turns.question: What was our cart abandonment rate between 20 September and 3 October 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no cart abandonment metric, so I can't give a figure for 20 September to 3 October 2026. The closest metric is cart-to-checkout rate, the share of site sessions with an add to cart that checked out on the same day or the day after, but that is not the same quantity as abandonment. No query was run, so there is no freshness statement to quote.
